title: SteamHappy Peepers
description: Changes the Peepers from Caverns and Chasms to be less freaky
body:
A friend of mine kept complaining about the Peepers from the Caverns and Chasms mod, saying that they look weird, and such other things i won't speak about here. this texturepack doesn't make them completely "family friendly", but does make them not stare at you as intensely, by changing their face sprite to that of the steamhappy emoji. 

The emoji uses the rest of the sprite's color pallette in both versions of the sprite, due to a happy accident caused by Aseprite.

The original sprite and mod made by [Team Abnormals.](https://modrinth.com/organization/teamabnormals)

### Enjoy!
